title: What Happened to Cheap Trucks? The $19,995 Pickup Now Costs $27,145
description:
What happened to cheap trucks: the Ford Maverick's climb from $19,995 to $27,145, the five cheapest pickups of 2026, what inflation really explains, where the cheap trucks went, and the new wave of affordable trucks (Slate, Ford Fathom, Ram Dakota). Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
1:33 The Maverick's price climb
4:27 The cheapest trucks in 2026
7:17 Is it just inflation?
10:48 Where the cheap trucks went
13:03 The Maverick effect
15:09 The new cheap trucks: Slate, Fathom, Dakota
18:25 How to get a cheap truck now
20:35 The verdict
